overview: Host Laura Duggan interviewed Medford Poet Laureate, teacher, musician, and brewer Max Heinegg about his poetry, musical projects, and Medford Brewing Company, followed by announcements for local Patriots Day events.

items.title: Introduction of Guest Max Heinegg
items.summary: Host Laura Duggan introduced guest Max Heinegg, Medford's Poet Laureate, high school English teacher, musician, and co-founder of Medford Brewing Company.

items.title: Poetry Writing Background and Creative Process
items.summary: Heinegg discussed starting to write poetry at age 15 inspired by high school English teachers and theater, and explained his voice-to-text and drafting process.

items.title: Reading of "Keepers of the House"
items.summary: Heinegg read his poem "Keepers of the House" from his collection about teaching at Medford High School and discussed the impact of student drug addiction.

items.title: Reading of "Joy Division"
items.summary: Heinegg read his poem "Joy Division," written during COVID-19 pandemic walks in Oak Grove Cemetery with his daughter.

items.title: Reading of 9/11 History Poem
items.summary: Duggan read a poem by Heinegg reflecting on the personal impact and challenges of teaching students about September 11, 2001.

items.title: Presentation of "Between the Rocks"
items.summary: Heinegg described sonnet crowns and read selections from "Between the Rocks," a poem inspired by family travel and Mayan history in Tulum, Mexico.

items.title: Reading of "Ava at 13"
items.summary: Heinegg read "Ava, 13," a poem reflecting on parenthood and his daughter growing up.

items.title: Musical Career and Dickinson Performance
items.summary: Heinegg summarized his musical career with Boston-area bands and performed a guitar adaptation of Emily Dickinson's poem "Wild Nights."

items.title: Medford Brewing Company and Community Outreach
items.summary: Heinegg detailed the history of Medford Brewing Company in West Medford, brewing operations, draft sales, and local community events.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Patriots Day Announcements
items.summary: Duggan celebrated her show's 75th episode, presented Heinegg with a gift, and promoted upcoming Patriots Day events including the unveiling of the Sarah Bradley Fulton statue at Medford City Hall.
